definitions.explanation: A lens or device that makes objects appear larger than they are. Includes handheld magnifying glasses, loupes, and digital magnification tools.

examples.japanese: {拡大鏡|かくだいきょう}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧。
examples.english: To look through a magnifying glass.

examples.japanese: ⟦{小|ちい}さな→小さな：02913_chiisana⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}む→読む：00426_yomu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{拡大鏡|かくだいきょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}っている→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
examples.english: I use a magnifying glass to read small print.

examples.japanese: ⟦スマートフォン→スマートフォン：04434_sumaatofon⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧{拡大鏡|かくだいきょう}⟦{機能|きのう}→機能：13165_kinou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧ついて⟦いて→いる：00495_iru⟧、⟦カメラ→カメラ：04417_kamera⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{文字|もじ}→文字：03632_moji⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{映|うつ}せる→映す：12963_utsusu⟧。
examples.english: Smartphones also have a magnifier function, allowing you to enlarge text using the camera.

notes: Compound: ⟦{拡大|かくだい}→拡大：02553_kakudai⟧ (enlargement) + {鏡|きょう} (mirror/lens). Also called ルーペ (loupe — from German) or ⟦{虫眼鏡|むしめがね}→虫眼鏡：05597_mushimegane⟧ (magnifying glass — literally 'insect-viewing lens', more colloquial). In computing, {拡大鏡|かくだいきょう} refers to the screen magnifier accessibility feature. Related: ⟦{虫眼鏡|むしめがね}→虫眼鏡：05597_mushimegane⟧ (magnifying glass — everyday word), ルーペ (loupe), ⟦{顕微鏡|けんびきょう}→顕微鏡：05482_kenbikyou⟧ (microscope), ⟦{望遠鏡|ぼうえんきょう}→望遠鏡：05483_bouenkyou⟧ (telescope).
